uplink.description: Clamp metering frame: current, voltage and active power for one clamp (socket 0 / channel 0)
uplink._note: Synthetic clamp frame built to the upstream object-stream layout (header 0x00 + declared length, then three type-0x40 clamp objects with measure codes 1=current/10=voltage/4=power). expected.data derived by running reference/upstream-codec.js (oracle: current 5000 mA, voltage 230 V, power 1500 W) and mapping mA->A (power.current), V (power.voltage), W (power.active). Each clamp is a sub-sensor position, so it lands in the reserved `channels` array labelled `s<socket>c<channel>` after the vendor's own `clamp_s0_c0` identifier; nothing is repeated at the top level. Satisfies power-meter through the entry (power.current/voltage/active).

uplink.description: Three-phase block: four measures across three clamps on socket 1, one clamp exporting (negative active power)
uplink._note: Synthetic frame exercising the multi-sample clamp path: four type-0x40 objects with the socket/channel byte present (object byte 0x41, sc byte 0x20 = socket 1 / channel 0), each carrying count=3 samples so the codec walks channel+c into three separate clamps. Measure codes 1=current, 10=voltage, 4=power, 3=consumedActiveEnergyIndex. expected.data derived by running reference/upstream-codec.js, which returns clamp_s1_c0..c2 with current 4500/5250/6000 mA, voltage 230.1/231/229.5 V, power 1030/1210/-450 W (the last exercising the 3-byte two's-complement sign path) and consumedActiveEnergyIndex 123450/234560/345670 Wh; mapped per clamp to power.current (mA->A), power.voltage, power.active and metering.energy.total. Proves per-position separation: one `channels` entry per clamp, no cross-clamp flattening.

uplink.description: Declared payload length does not match actual length -> error
uplink._note: The header's declared length byte must equal total length - 2; a mismatch is rejected (mirrors the upstream guard).
